bioconda.name: spatial-continuum
bioconda.summary: Universal biophysical reaction-diffusion transport framework and Bedside Composite Resistance Index (CRI) for NSCLC.
bioconda.description: A zero-dependency biophysical transport framework and bedside clinical decision engine solving steady-state reaction-diffusion equations across perivascular cords and avascular nests, evaluating pharmacological sanctuaries, and computing the Composite Resistance Index (CRI) in EGFR-mutant lung adenocarcinoma.
